constructor_sites.expression: _add_box(at + Vector3(0, dimensions.y * 0.5 + 0.015, 0), Vector3(dimensions.x + 0.08, 0.05, dimensions.z + 0.08), dark, false)
_add_box(Vector3(x, at.y, at.z + dimensions.z * 0.5 + 0.025), Vector3(0.038, dimensions.y - 0.12, 0.045), dark, false)
_add_box(Vector3(x, at.y, at.z - dimensions.z * 0.5 - 0.025), Vector3(0.038, dimensions.y - 0.12, 0.045), dark, false)
_add_box(Vector3(at.x + dimensions.x * 0.5 + 0.026, at.y, z), Vector3(0.045, dimensions.y - 0.12, 0.038), dark, false)
_add_box(Vector3(at.x + sx * (dimensions.x * 0.5), at.y, at.z), Vector3(0.08, dimensions.y + 0.05, 0.10), dark, false)
var hidden_blocker := _add_box(center + Vector3(0, float(levels) * 0.17, 0), Vector3(float(count) * 0.86, float(levels) * 0.34, 0.39), Color(0.50, 0.47, 0.34), true)
model.mesh = cube if solid or dimensions[dimensions.min_axis_index()] < 0.035 else ModelSurface.body(dimensions, ModelSurface.Profile.MACHINED)
var mount_mesh := ModelSurface.body(Vector3(0.034, mount_top - mount_bottom, 0.038), ModelSurface.Profile.MACHINED)
var rim := ModelSurface.body(Vector3(0.086, 0.009, 0.018) if edge_index < 2 else Vector3(0.009, 0.083, 0.018), ModelSurface.Profile.MACHINED)
var hip := _joint(visual_root, Vector3(side * 0.19, -0.34, 0), "LeftHip" if side < 0.0 else "RightHip")
var shoulder := _joint(torso_pivot, Vector3(side * 0.36, 0.39, -0.04), "LeftShoulder" if side < 0.0 else "RightShoulder")
muzzle_flash = _part(weapon_pivot, muzzle_shape, Vector3(0.0, -0.04, muzzle_z), Color(1.0, 0.58, 0.25), "MuzzleFlash", Vector3(PI * 0.5, 0, 0))
var hip := _joint(visual, Vector3(side * 0.19, -0.34, 0), "LeftHip" if side < 0.0 else "RightHip")
var shoulder := _joint(visual, Vector3(side * 0.36, 0.31, -0.035), "LeftShoulder" if side < 0.0 else "RightShoulder")
